reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-cica Glow Sun Ampoule 50ml
reviews.text: This sunscreen runs in my eyes and burns. Like even after I dab my face to get rid of some of the extra moisture . However it a wonderful lotiony serum texture and absorbs pretty well otherwise. It fantastic on the rest of my body and neck… if you don’t have sensitive eyes or anything this might not be a problem for you. I’m a huge fan of this line and will probably buy it again to reapply on my arms and hands during the day.
reviews.zh: 呢款防曬會流到入眼，而且會刺刺地痛。即使我輕輕印乾塊面抹走部分多餘嘅水分，情況都係咁。不過佢嘅乳液精華質地真係好正，吸收都幾快。搽喺身體其他部位同條頸都好正……如果你冇眼敏感嘅話，可能就冇呢個問題。我好鍾意呢個系列，好大機會會再買嚟日間補搽手臂同手。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-cica Glow Sun Ampoule 50ml
reviews.text: El ProBio-Cica Glow Serum Ampoule Sunscreen es una excelente opción si buscas un protector solar con múltiples beneficios para la piel. Su textura ligera, su fórmula calmante e hidratante y su acabado luminoso lo hacen destacar entre otros protectores solares. Es especialmente recomendable para pieles sensibles, mixtas o deshidratadas, aunque si prefieres un acabado completamente mate, quizá no sea la mejor opción.
reviews.zh: El ProBio-Cica Glow Serum Ampoule Sunscreen 係一個出色嘅選擇，如果你想搵一支有多重護膚功效嘅防曬。佢質地輕盈，配方有舒緩同保濕效果，加上水光妝效，令佢喺眾多防曬之中脫穎而出。特別推薦畀敏感肌、混合性或缺水肌使用；不過如果你偏好完全霧面妝效，呢款未必係最佳選擇。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-cica Glow Sun Ampoule 50ml
reviews.text: It has a lightweight, serum-like texture that absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy or heavy feeling. The centella and probiotic ingredients help soothe my sensitive skin, and I love the natural glow it gives. No white cast, no irritation, and it works beautifully under makeup. Perfect for daily use—definitely a new favorite!
reviews.zh: 佢質地輕盈似精華，吸收得快，唔會有油笠或者厚重嘅感覺。積雪草同益生菌成分有助舒緩我嘅敏感肌，而且我好鍾意佢帶嚟嘅自然光澤感。唔會泛白，又唔刺激，搽咗化妝底下都好貼服。日常用一流——絕對係新寵！

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-cica Glow Sun Ampoule 50ml
reviews.text: I was in the market for a new sunscreen and this product arrived just in time! I’m a big fan of cica in skincare products since my skin tends to feel really sensitive in the morning. I use it before my workouts and I bring it when I travel. Great buy!
reviews.zh: 我本嚟就想買支新嘅防曬，呢支產品啱啱好嚟得合時！我好鍾意護膚品入面有積雪草成分，因為我朝早皮膚成日都會覺得好敏感。我會喺做運動前搽，去旅行都會帶住用。買得抵！

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-cica Glow Sun Ampoule 50ml
reviews.text: I like all the skin1004 items but this isn't it. It smells weird and also is very tacky when I put it on
reviews.zh: 我鍾意晒所有 skin1004 嘅產品，但呢款真係唔得。塗上去味道好怪，而且非常黏笠。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-cica Glow Sun Ampoule 50ml
reviews.text: I have tried this product for two days. I love the Skin 1004 sun block but this formula is even better. It melt into skin. It is light and still very moisturizing. This is going to be my go to sunscreen. It look great under my makeup and doesn’t irritate my skin. Can’t say enough good about this product.
reviews.zh: 我用咗呢款產品兩日。我好鍾意 Skin 1004 嘅防曬，但呢款配方仲要好。佢會融入皮膚，質感輕盈但依然非常保濕。呢款會成為我嘅常用防曬。搽完再上妝效果好好，而且唔會刺激我嘅皮膚。對呢款產品點讚都唔為過。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-cica Glow Sun Ampoule 50ml
reviews.text:
It gives me confidence that my skin is in good hands whenever I wear this sunscreen. It is so soothing specially whenever after I shave my facial hair. Shaving alone irritates my sensitive skin and other sunscreen I’ve used before irritates it even more — one of the reasons why I didn’t like sunscreen. But not this one. 

SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-cica sunscreen not only protects my skin from the radiating sun. It also helps my skin heal from any irritation. I highly recommend it!
reviews.zh:
每次搽呢款防曬都畀我信心，覺得皮膚受到好好嘅照顧。佢非常舒緩，尤其係我剃走面部毛髮之後。剃毛本身已經會刺激我嘅敏感肌，之前用過嘅其他防曬仲刺激得更厲害——正因為咁，我先一直唔鍾意用防曬。但呢款就唔會。

SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-cica 防曬唔單止保護我嘅皮膚免受猛烈陽光傷害，仲有助舒緩任何刺激。我非常推薦！

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-cica Glow Sun Ampoule 50ml
reviews.text: I absolutely love this sunscreen! It is super sheer, so no white cast. It rubs in so easily and leaves a nice glow on my skin. Also, the packaging is so pretty which I always expect from SKIN1004. If you are looking for a new lightweight sunscreen, I highly recommend :)
reviews.zh: 我完全愛上咗呢款防曬！佢超級通透，所以完全唔會泛白。非常容易推開，仲會喺皮膚上面留低好靚嘅光澤。而且包裝好靚，我對 SKIN1004 一直都係有呢個期望。如果你喺搵一款新嘅輕盈防曬，我非常推薦 :)
